tex_content.html:
On $M_\infty \times (-\infty ,0)$, with $\tau =-t$, \[ \Ric _{g_\infty (t)}+\Hess ^{g_\infty (t)}l_\infty (\cdot ,\tau ) -\frac1{2\tau }g_\infty (t)=0. \]
Proof

↗ def:ricci-flow \sketch Apply Lemma 2.7 with $f=l_\infty $. Equation 4 says that $u$ satisfies the conjugate heat equation, while Equation 5 makes the corresponding $v$ identically zero. The evolution identity for $v$ then forces the displayed squared norm to vanish because $u>0$.

□

Lemma
[Conjugate heat equation identity for gradient shrinking solitons]
